name: dsh-workspace-auto-sort
description: Automatic sidebar Workspace ordering: the sidebar's Workspace group order IS the Workspace registry's durable display order, so a Host-only plugin keeps it sorted after every durable write — recomputing the desired order from title/path/createdAt with optional pinned entries, then applying it through the registry's own insertBefore (DOM insertBefore semantics) as an insertion sort of at most n-1 moves. The browser follows the resulting order through the workspace controller's follow() stream, so nothing in the UI is patched and a reconnecting client sees the same order. The default order is updated-desc (most recently changed first), which is safe precisely because a registry reorder writes only the global order singleton and never touches a workspace record: updatedAt advances only through entity mutations (create, rename, session accounting, in-workspace session reorder), so the plugin's own writes can never move their own sort key.
